earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: GAAP net revenue was $1.50 billion, compared to $1.77 billion in last year’s fiscal second quarter.
Fiscal second quarter Net Bookings were $1.60 billion
Total Net Bookings* decreased 18% to $1.60 billion compared to $1.96 billion during last year’s fiscal second quarter.
Net Bookings from recurrent consumer spending** decreased 9% and accounted for 81% of total Net Bookings.
Recurrent consumer spending** decreased 5% and accounted for 81% of total GAAP net revenue.

quotes.text: The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company.

outlook: Company updates fiscal year 2027 outlook and reiterates expectation for Net Bookings of $8.0 to $8.2 billion

items.heading: The inability of our products to achieve significant market acceptance, the failure to retain existing players, delays in product releases or disruptions following the commercial release of our products may have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition and operating results.
items.group: Risks relating to our business and industry

items.heading: We are subject to product development risks which could result in delays and additional costs, and we must adapt to changes in software technologies.
items.group: Risks relating to our business and industry

items.heading: Our quarterly and annual operating results are dependent on the release of hit titles and therefore dependent on the timing of our product releases, which may cause our quarterly operating results to fluctuate significantly.
items.group: Risks relating to our business and industry

items.heading: We are dependent on the future success of our Grand Theft Auto products and other hit titles, and we must continue to publish hit titles or sequels to such hit titles in order to compete successfully in our industry.
The development, use, and incorporation of artificial intelligence (“AI”) into our products and within our industry may present operational, reputational, financial, and competition risks.
Our business is subject to our ability to develop commercially successful products for the current video game platforms.
